question: Tổng doanh thu theo từng danh mục sản phẩm
gold_sql: SELECT category_name, ROUND(SUM(quantity * price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM online_retail GROUP BY category_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: Top 5 sản phẩm bán chạy nhất theo tổng số lượng
gold_sql: SELECT product_name, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM online_retail GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Thống kê doanh thu theo từng phương thức thanh toán
gold_sql: SELECT payment_method, ROUND(SUM(quantity * price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM online_retail GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: Số lượng đơn hàng theo thành phố
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM online_retail GROUP BY city ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Trung bình điểm đánh giá review_score theo danh mục sản phẩm
gold_sql: SELECT category_name, ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_score FROM online_retail GROUP BY category_name ORDER BY avg_score DESC;

question: Doanh thu trung bình theo độ tuổi khách hàng
gold_sql: SELECT age, ROUND(AVG(quantity * price), 2) AS avg_revenue FROM online_retail GROUP BY age ORDER BY age ASC;

question: Tổng số khách hàng nam và nữ mua sắm
gold_sql: SELECT gender, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS total_customers FROM online_retail GROUP BY gender;

question: Danh sách các đơn hàng trong tháng 12 năm 2024
gold_sql: SELECT customer_id, order_date, product_name, quantity, price FROM online_retail WHERE order_date >= '2024-12-01' AND order_date <= '2024-12-31' LIMIT 50;

question: Doanh thu danh mục Electronics theo phương thức thanh toán
gold_sql: SELECT payment_method, ROUND(SUM(quantity * price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM online_retail WHERE category_name = 'Electronics' GROUP BY payment_method;

question: Sản phẩm có đơn giá cao nhất
gold_sql: SELECT product_name, category_name, price FROM online_retail ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Tổng số lượng sản phẩm Smartphone đã bán
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) AS total_smartphone_sold FROM online_retail WHERE product_name = 'Smartphone';

question: Top 3 thành phố có doanh thu lớn nhất
gold_sql: SELECT city, ROUND(SUM(quantity * price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM online_retail GROUP BY city ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Doanh thu theo từng tháng trong năm 2024
gold_sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', order_date) AS month, ROUND(SUM(quantity * price), 2) AS monthly_revenue FROM online_retail WHERE order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND order_date <= '2024-12-31' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month ASC;

question: Số đơn hàng thanh toán bằng Credit Card có review_score 5 sao
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS five_star_credit_card_orders FROM online_retail WHERE payment_method = 'Credit Card' AND review_score = 5.0;

question: Danh mục sản phẩm có điểm đánh giá trung bình cao nhất
gold_sql: SELECT category_name, ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_rating FROM online_retail GROUP BY category_name ORDER BY avg_rating DESC LIMIT 1;

question: Tổng doanh thu nhóm khách hàng trên 50 tuổi
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity * price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM online_retail WHERE age > 50;

question: Doanh thu theo danh mục Fashion đối với khách hàng nữ
gold_sql: SELECT product_name, ROUND(SUM(quantity * price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM online_retail WHERE category_name = 'Fashion' AND gender = 'F' GROUP BY product_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

question: Trung bình giá tiền các sản phẩm thuộc danh mục Books & Stationery
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM online_retail WHERE category_name = 'Books & Stationery';

question: Doanh thu
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(quantity * price), 2) AS total_revenue FROM online_retail;

question: Số đơn hàng được mua bằng phương thức Cash on Delivery
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cod_order_count FROM online_retail WHERE payment_method = 'Cash on Delivery';
